verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only indirect spend-bounding. The upto scheme lets a buyer authorize a maximum per payment and settle only what was used. Batch settlement uses explicit escrow with "cryptographically signed" limits plus buyer refund and withdrawal semantics, which caps exposure to the escrowed amount. Agentic accounts give an agent its own funded wallet, so its balance acts as a de facto ceiling. Missing for 10: documented per-agent spend caps or budget policies, per-agent usage or rate limits, an instant revocation mechanism for an agent's payment authority, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of these controls.
